raid.title: Capabilities are global
raid.description: FLOW assumes capabilities are global while process execution may contain controlled regional variants.
raid.mitigation: Confirm as an enterprise-model principle and apply it consistently in capability and process artefacts.
raid.escalation: Approve in programme design principles.

raid.title: Value Stream Owners and capability SMEs are not fully confirmed
raid.description: The process plan depends on decision-capable owners and SMEs for workshops, validation and sign-off.
raid.mitigation: Complete owner/SME nominations with Peter; confirm availability and decision rights before workshops.
raid.escalation: Escalate unowned value streams or capabilities.

raid.title: Process workshops depend on FLOW education and named SMEs
raid.description: Effective validation requires participants to understand the FLOW enterprise model and have authority to make decisions.
raid.mitigation: Sequence FLOW education and stakeholder confirmation before value-stream and capability workshops.
raid.escalation: Resolve missing participants before workshop invitations are finalised.

raid.title: Integrated plan is not baselined
raid.description: Workstream activities, sequencing, resource demand and dependencies may continue in separate plans without one approved programme baseline.
raid.mitigation: Agree planning standards; require each workstream owner to submit and maintain a workstream plan; integrate into the programme baseline and review weekly.
raid.escalation: SteerCo to confirm plan ownership, baseline date and change-control approach.

raid.title: FLOW narrative is not consistently understood
raid.description: Uneven understanding of FLOW, value streams, capabilities, processes and data domains could cause fragmented engagement and premature design activity.
raid.mitigation: Agree a simple FLOW narrative; align ExCo first; deliver targeted education to FLOW members, Value Stream Owners and SMEs before workshops.
raid.escalation: ExCo sponsorship required for one consistent programme message.

raid.title: Integrated workstream baseline is not yet approved
raid.description: The activity catalogue exists, but dates, dependencies, resource commitments and ownership still require workstream validation and programme approval.
raid.mitigation: Run workstream planning reviews; resolve conflicts; approve baseline and establish change control.
raid.escalation: SteerCo approval of baseline and critical path.

raid.title: Insufficient SME capacity and backfill
raid.description: Required business experts may not have protected time for design, validation and sign-off, delaying decisions or reducing quality.
raid.mitigation: Complete SME capacity assessment; quantify demand by workshop and value stream; agree backfills and escalation route for unavailable SMEs.
raid.escalation: ExCo decision may be required for protected capacity and backfill funding.

raid.title: QualiWare and CZP traceability are not ready
raid.description: New process outputs may be created in spreadsheets or presentations without controlled relationships to CZPs, ownership, status and decision records.
raid.mitigation: Define QualiWare structure, modelling standard, CZP mapping, version control and review cycle before bulk process updates.
raid.escalation: Confirm QualiWare as the governed process source and agree minimum metadata.

raid.title: Brazil data outside core systems is incomplete or unknown
raid.description: Operational, supply-chain, warehouse or billing data held in spreadsheets may be missed from migration scope, quality analysis and integration design.
raid.mitigation: Complete Brazil spreadsheet inventory including purpose, owner, volume, format, macros/lookups, quality and retention needs.
raid.escalation: Regional sponsors to provide access and accountable data contacts.

raid.title: SUN replacement critical path is not agreed
raid.description: Technology, process, data and partner plans may sequence work inconsistently if the D365/SUN replacement path and dependent platforms are not baselined.
raid.mitigation: Produce application dependency map and integrated technology sequence; validate D365 scope, SUN retirement assumptions, tax, treasury and integration dependencies.
raid.escalation: SteerCo to approve the near-term technology sequence and mobilisation priorities.

raid.title: Standard functionality is preferred
raid.description: FLOW assumes standard platform functionality is used before customisation, subject to genuine business, legal, tax or control requirements.
raid.mitigation: Include the principle in architecture standards and require documented justification for exceptions.
raid.escalation: Design Authority decision on exception criteria.

raid.title: QualiWare is the process source of truth
raid.description: The plan assumes QualiWare will hold approved process structures, CZP references, ownership, status and governance records.
raid.mitigation: Confirm repository scope, access, structure and minimum metadata.
raid.escalation: Programme governance to confirm repository decision.

raid.title: Capabilities and value streams are not formally agreed
raid.description: Process, data and technology teams may design against different enterprise models if value streams, capability definitions and ownership remain unconfirmed.
raid.mitigation: Validate the value-stream model; baseline the capability catalogue and definitions; assign owners and SMEs; record approvals.
raid.escalation: Escalate unresolved scope or ownership disputes to programme governance.

raid.title: Partner work proceeds without common standards
raid.description: HSO, EPAM, Avalara, Kyriba and other partners may produce overlapping or inconsistent artefacts without shared delivery, architecture, security and data standards.
raid.mitigation: Issue partner guidelines; define deliverable standards, governance, dependency reporting and approval gates; align SOWs to FLOW outcomes.
raid.escalation: Confirm partner governance and accountable internal design authority.

raid.title: Funding and SOW decisions delay mobilisation
raid.description: Unresolved commercial scope, partner SOWs or funding decisions may delay resource onboarding and January mobilisation.
raid.mitigation: Maintain procurement/SOW tracker; identify decision dates, dependencies and cost exposure; escalate decisions through SteerCo and ExCo.
raid.escalation: Confirm approved mobilisation funding and authorised commitments.

raid.title: TO-BE work starts before TOM decisions
raid.description: Detailed future processes or partner designs may reproduce the current organisation or embed technology assumptions before operating-model choices are agreed.
raid.mitigation: Use TOM approval and design principles as gates; distinguish process standards from detailed workflows; prioritise decision-critical processes.
raid.escalation: Confirm which TO-BE artefacts are expected before ExCo TOM approval.

raid.title: Regional variants become uncontrolled local models
raid.description: Regional differences may be embedded invisibly or treated as separate operating models, weakening global standards and increasing complexity.
raid.mitigation: Apply global capabilities and global process standards; document justified regional variants; require CRB approval and QualiWare traceability.
raid.escalation: CRB must approve the regional-variant criteria and exception route.

raid.title: Data ownership and systems of record are unclear
raid.description: Cleansing, migration, reconciliation and ongoing governance may stall if critical domains do not have accountable owners, stewards and authoritative sources.
raid.mitigation: Baseline data domains; assign owners and stewards; identify systems of record; agree governance and issue-resolution paths.
raid.escalation: ExCo may need to nominate accountable business data owners.

raid.title: Leadership does not reinforce standard ways of working
raid.description: Users may retain bespoke or legacy practices if leadership messages, decisions and escalation behaviour do not consistently support adoption.
raid.mitigation: Define sponsor behaviours; include stop/start behaviours in communication; track adoption and escalate repeated exceptions.
raid.escalation: ExCo to agree visible sponsorship and reinforcement expectations.

raid.title: January 2027 mobilisation remains the planning target
raid.description: Current planning assumes sufficient governance, sequencing, resources and partner readiness are established to mobilise in January 2027.
raid.mitigation: Validate through mobilisation-readiness review and record any conditions or exceptions.
raid.escalation: Decision required if readiness criteria are not met.

raid.title: Technology design depends on TOM, processes and data requirements
raid.description: Detailed platform fit-gap, architecture and integration design require sufficiently stable business outcomes, process standards and data needs.
raid.mitigation: Define design gates and minimum inputs for partner discovery and solution design.
raid.escalation: Design Authority to enforce entry criteria.

raid.title: Non-functional requirements remain unmeasurable
raid.description: Vague expectations for availability, performance, security, resilience, auditability and supportability could prevent objective design and acceptance.
raid.mitigation: Create an NFR catalogue with measurable acceptance criteria, owner, applicable platform/region and validation method; include in supplier evaluation and testing.
raid.escalation: Design Authority to approve minimum NFR standard and exceptions.

raid.title: Integration landscape and ownership are incomplete
raid.description: Unknown interfaces, point-to-point dependencies or unclear support ownership may cause missed scope, failed transactions and cutover risk.
raid.mitigation: Complete integration inventory and interface catalogue; assign ownership; define target integrations, monitoring and retirement requirements.
raid.escalation: Confirm accountable integration owner and architecture review route.

raid.title: Migration planning depends on source inventory and retention decisions
raid.description: Source-to-target mapping and migration waves cannot be reliably baselined until sources, systems of record and historical-retention rules are agreed.
raid.mitigation: Complete source inventory and ownership; obtain audit, tax and operational retention decisions.
raid.escalation: Decision owners required for historical-data retention.

raid.title: Detailed deployment sequence is not agreed
raid.description: Deployment, testing and cutover activities currently remain roadmap placeholders rather than an approved baseline.
raid.mitigation: Complete technology sequence and application dependency map; then create deployment options and decision points.
raid.escalation: SteerCo decision after architecture and partner plans mature.

raid.title: Testing depends on environments, data, integrations and business availability
raid.description: SIT, E2E and UAT require stable builds, representative test data, available SMEs and completed integration scope.
raid.mitigation: Build an integrated test-readiness checklist and align it to deployment milestones.
raid.escalation: Go/no-go authority and UAT ownership must be agreed.
